# custom_note (Resource)

Manages a note.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Manage example note.
resource "custom_note" "example" {
  text = "Build custom terraform provider"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `text` (String) Note content.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) String uuid identifier of the note.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Order can be imported by specifying the string uuid identifier.
terraform import custom_note.example 3f5b4d2e-8c12-4b8b-8cbb-3df2bcad50e5
```
